## Constraints

### Must

- Product: an interactive crypto/memecoin brand website for Cat Purrcessing Unit ($CPU) on HyperEVM — an editorial, experimental web experience, not an app dashboard or SaaS product
- Dark-only: every surface is black (#0B0F12) or deep green-black (#031613/#04201B); there is no light theme. The detector reports light-and-dark only because Tailwind v4 declares tokens under :root/@theme
- Energy colour is Hyperliquid teal #00F0E6 with mint #97FCE4; white #FBF9FB is for type; graphite #2A2F36 for hardware; pink appears only on the cat's ears
- One continuous page-level environment (fixed halftone WebGL + glass light) behind transparent sections; sections are content planes, not boxed panels
- Hierarchy through space, type scale, alignment, light and motion before borders and cards; radius is used deliberately (mostly sharp, rounded only for glass/visor forms)
- Community 21st.dev components carry the signature interaction of each section; Radix/shadcn primitives only underneath for accessibility
- Keep real market and reward logic unchanged; show Unavailable rather than 0 or a guess when data is missing
- Keep uploaded PFP images local to the browser
- Use only official CPU art (crops, mattes and extractions of supplied art are fine)

### Avoid

- Light-mode or light SaaS UI of any kind
- Generic dashboard layouts, KPI card rows and card grids
- Card/Tabs/Input/Button assemblies as a section's visual identity
- Purple or rainbow gradients
- Pill navigation, fake terminals, fake blockchain nodes and decorative particles
- APY, projections or reward forecasts presented as outcomes
- Multiple always-running WebGL canvases
- New generated CPU character artwork or generic sci-fi armour

## Decisions

- **site-environment**: Promote the raw WebGL halftone into one fixed SiteEnvironment; section roots stay transparent and GSAP ScrollTrigger re-lights the world per section (src/features/environment/site-environment.tsx)
- **pfp-render-pipeline**: Compose the PFP kit with Canvas 2D from raster/SVG assets extracted from official art; one drawPfp() renders preview and 2048px export; no Three.js (src/features/engine/compose.ts)
- **interaction-locks**: src/lib/scroll-lock.ts is the only owner of page scroll locking; loader lifecycle, nav inert/visibility and environment pointer-events are functionally locked (src/lib/scroll-lock.ts)
